items.prompt: Why do "aab" and "aba" have equal canonical keys, unlike "abb"?

options.text: All three have the same letter set.
options.why: Set equality is too weak because it forgets counts.
All three have length 3, but the a/b multiplicities differ.

options.text: The first two both contain two a letters and one b.
options.why: Their sorted strings are aab; abb instead contains one a and two b letters.

options.text: The first and last characters must match.
options.why: Anagrams do not require fixed character positions.

items.explanation: Their sorted strings are aab; abb instead contains one a and two b letters.
